persons.name: Bhūpatīndramalla
persons.evidence: śrī 2 bhūpatīndramallo jayati ... proccaiḥ prālekhayet tāṃ nayanakulamaṇiḥ sādaraṃ bhūpatīndraḥ

date.as_written: nepālaśāke rasaśaśibhujagaiḥ sanvite(!) pauṣamāse , yoge kṛṣṇadaśamyāṃ dinakaradivase maitrabhe ca dhruvākhye

notes: Bhūpatīndramalla, King of Bhaktapur, is stated to have commissioned the manuscript (prālekhayet). The year is given via chronogram: rasa (6), śaśi (1), bhujaga (8) = NS 816.
